source_review.identity: Printed XM029, LM register bit receivers for parity predict title, part 2586350, 05-28-70 date and BR footer agree with the native source.
source_review.coverage: Compared the complete native overview, all nine enlarged source sectors, focused 3A/3H stages, right continuation labels and footer, and corrected complete 245x103 preview.
key_findings: Nine receiver groups, resistor taps and inversion branches preserve distinct parity ranges and the source's plain crossing rails. Every input driver was traced through its source-specific doglegs.

The worn upper 3A designation is represented as BB with its source glyph ambiguity documented; the right output prints BB4 and the separate 3H stage prints BE. Left +BITS 46-47 EVEN preserves the missing ARE literally.

Restored each right output wire through the signal to its designation, restored plural BITS in BC4, and corrected terminal triangles to match this sheet: AR and 4060 N inputs unmarked, 4060 N outputs marked, 3106 N outputs unmarked. All stacked output continuation pages and diamonds agree with the scan.
source_review.validation: PASS: 36/36 direct A1 card portions; 36 printed input terminals; 103 rows x 245 columns; no unsupported characters, duplicate pins, disconnected nets, hidden junctions, text collisions or unreadable characters.

invalidation: Any change to source or an accepted artifact requires a new native and preview audit before acceptance.
